.acv-figure .acv-scroll{max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior-x:contain;border:1px solid #d7e2ea;border-radius:12px;background:#fff}

.acv-figure svg{display:block;width:100%;min-width:650px;height:auto;max-height:400px;background:#fff}
.acv-figure svg text{font-family:DejaVu Sans,Arial,sans-serif}
.reveal .acv-figure{margin:.4rem 0}
.reveal .acv-figure .acv-caption{font-size:.7em}
